svg.aria-label: Yayın — Your GitHub sites, under your own domain. Add a static site from a GitHub repository and it is served at its own subdomain — the FY Language site runs at dil-platform.fyajan.com. One Cloudflare Worker, no build step; a cron checks every project every ten minutes.
